title: The Diamond Rain of Ice Giants
hook: Your jewelry is actually a common weather pattern on other planets.
script: Your jewelry is actually a common weather pattern on other planets. Deep in the atmospheres of Neptune and Uranus, the physics of weather change. What if you could stand under a sky where it literally rains gemstones? The extreme pressure squeezes carbon atoms into solid crystals. This creates a constant downpour of diamond rain. These diamonds are heavy enough to sink for thousands of kilometers. They eventually pool into a slushy ocean of liquid diamond deep inside the planet. This ocean is larger than any sea on Earth. Send this to the person who thinks diamonds are rare.
